visualize_image_tensor: visualize a PyTorch image tensor by saving it as a PNG file to disk
visualize_feature_maps: visualize feature maps and masks with seed highlighting and save to a folder
visualize_eigenvector: visualize an eigenvector array by zooming and saving it as a color-mapped image
visualize_predictions_and_ground_truth: visualize predicted bounding boxes and ground truth boxes overlaid on an image
visualize_attention_maps: visualize LOST attention maps by binarizing similarity and saving inverse degree as an image
